firstNightReminder: The Fearmonger chooses a player. :reminder: Announce that the Fearmonger has chosen a player.
otherNightReminder: The Fearmonger chooses a player. :reminder: If the target is different to last night, announce that the Fearmonger has chosen a player.

en.name: Fearmonger
en.ability: Each night, choose a player. If you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.
en.flavor: Beware of gazing long into the Abyss, lest the Abyss also gaze into you.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose a player. If you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.

zh.name: 恐惧之灵
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择一名玩家：如果你提名他且他被处决，他的阵营落败。当你首次选择或更换目标时，所有玩家都会得知你选择了新的玩家。
